funds.name: SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust
funds.blurb: Owns a slice of all 500+ S&P 500 companies at once, so a bad day for one company barely dents the fund, unlike an individual stock where one earnings miss can swing the price double digits. Tracks all 500+ companies in the S&P 500, weighted by market cap, across every major U.S. sector.
funds.holdingsNote: Tracks all 500+ companies in the S&P 500, weighted by market cap, across every major U.S. sector.

funds.name: Vanguard 500 Index Fund Admiral Shares
funds.blurb: The mutual fund twin of an S&P 500 ETF: it owns the same 500-plus companies, so it moves almost exactly in line with the broad market and avoids the single-company risk that comes with owning one stock. Tracks the S&P 500 directly, holding roughly 500 large U.S. companies in the same proportions as the index.
funds.holdingsNote: Tracks the S&P 500 directly, holding roughly 500 large U.S. companies in the same proportions as the index.

funds.name: Fidelity Contrafund
funds.blurb: A manager actively picks roughly a few hundred large-cap growth stocks rather than tracking an index, so it's more diversified than any single stock but can still drift from the market depending on the manager's bets. Actively managed; the portfolio manager selects several hundred large-cap growth-oriented stocks, with heavy exposure to a few mega-cap tech names.
funds.holdingsNote: Actively managed; the portfolio manager selects several hundred large-cap growth-oriented stocks, with heavy exposure to a few mega-cap tech names.

funds.name: Invesco QQQ Trust
funds.blurb: Spreads money across the 100 largest non-financial Nasdaq companies, but its heavy tilt toward a handful of mega-cap tech names means it still swings noticeably harder than the broad market. Tracks the Nasdaq-100: the 100 largest non-financial companies listed on the Nasdaq, dominated by big tech.
funds.holdingsNote: Tracks the Nasdaq-100: the 100 largest non-financial companies listed on the Nasdaq, dominated by big tech.

funds.name: iShares Russell 2000 ETF
funds.blurb: Diversifies across roughly 2,000 small companies rather than one, but small-caps as a group are more sensitive to economic swings and have less cash cushion than large-caps, so volatility stays elevated even with diversification. Holds about 2,000 small-cap U.S. companies that make up the Russell 2000 Index.
funds.holdingsNote: Holds about 2,000 small-cap U.S. companies that make up the Russell 2000 Index.

funds.name: Cal-Maine Foods
funds.blurb: Q1 FY27 net sales (reported Sept 30) plunged 41.5% to $539.6M as an industry egg glut drove conventional egg prices down ~59%, flipping CALM to a $58.6M net loss; the stock sits near $66.67 awaiting Q2 FY27 results due January 2027.

funds.name: Chemed Corp
funds.blurb: Q2 2026 revenue rose 8.8% YoY to $673.3M as VITAS hospice revenue grew 11.9% on higher patient census and a lower Medicare Cap hit, prompting Chemed to raise full-year guidance; shares now trade near $539.82.

funds.name: Saia Inc
funds.blurb: Q2 2026 revenue grew 17.1% YoY to a record $956.5M as Saia's LTL terminal network expansion kept driving tonnage and share gains, though shares have pulled back to $344.38 from their 52-week high amid cost pressures.

funds.name: Wingstop
funds.blurb: Domestic same-store sales fell 7.5% in Q2 2026 as low-income-consumer pullback persisted, prompting Wingstop to cut full-year same-store sales guidance to -4% to -6%; shares now trade near $103.38, well below their 52-week high of $388.14.

funds.name: Hanmi Financial
funds.blurb: Shares sit near $31.60 after Q2 net income climbed to $23.5M ($0.79 EPS) on net interest income of $63.9M, up 1.0% sequentially on an improved funding mix; a ~$930M market cap still leaves it far more news-sensitive than a diversified bank ETF.

funds.name: UMH Properties
funds.blurb: Manufactured-housing REIT with a $1.31B market cap; small enough that a single piece of unexpected news can move the stock far more than a diversified REIT fund would.

funds.name: CEVA Inc
funds.blurb: Shares near $36.40; this semiconductor-IP licensor's small size (~$1.02B market cap) means a single contract win or chip-industry headline can still swing the stock sharply in a session.

funds.name: Ring Energy
funds.blurb: Permian Basin oil producer still trading near $1.22 with a $310M market cap; a sub-$2 share price keeps it one of the most volatile names on this entire watchlist.
